column1: # CIAAW Standard Atomic Weights 2024, transcribed as printed at https://ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm (read 2026-11-07).
# "The most recent Standard Atomic Weights are presented in this Table and they are based on the 'Atomic Weights 2021' report"
# (Prohaska et al., Pure Appl. Chem. 94(5), 573-600 (2022), doi:10.1515/pac-2019-0603); Gd, Lu and Zr were revised by the CIAAW in 2024.
# Columns: Z, symbol, standard atomic weight as printed (digit groups separated by spaces; `(n)` = the uncertainty in the last digits
# shown; `[a, b]` = an interval; `-` = the page prints a dash, no standard atomic weight), footnote letters as printed, and
# mass_number: NOT a CIAAW value, the convention of physure.conf for an element with no standard atomic weight (the mass number of
# a long-lived isotope, taken over from the Python package this module replaced).
# The Rust test tests/atomic_weights_ciaaw.rs holds the [AtomicWeights] section of physure.conf to this file.
